roadmap.goal: Give every physical VM execution a fresh AllocationId while retaining its stable WorkloadId owner and exact existing cleanup authorities.
roadmap.estimate_basis: Five hours for one bounded WorkloadLifecycle/action-contract cut plus fourteen pure/property activations; four hours for the seeded runtime close/reopen owner path; eight hours for six native Cloud Hypervisor scenarios and retained strace evidence.

baseline.step_01_01: Twelve focused reconciler cases include eleven semantic RED cases and one intentional preservation control; two transitioned reclamation properties are semantic RED.
baseline.step_01_02: Seed 257205 reaches registered production owners and fails because replacement still completes under the predecessor AllocationId before the fresh beacon exists.
baseline.step_01_03: Six qualified-metal bodies compile; current same-ID behavior cannot satisfy their distinct-row, disjoint-artifact, SVID, and second-VMM oracles.
baseline.native_failures: GH #284 retains both EADDRINUSE on replacement beacon bind and ENOENT after predecessor cleanup removes replacement staging.

delivery_protocol: Execute 01-01, 01-02, then 01-03. Each step uses a fresh isolated nw-software-crafter on GPT-5.6 Luna/max for RED-GREEN-COMMIT and a fresh isolated reviewer on GPT-5.6 Luna/max.
The original step crafter remediates every finding; the same step reviewer re-reviews without an iteration cap until APPROVED and writes deliver/review-<step-id>.md before the next step starts.

Crafters remove only their step's reasoned pending markers. They never author, replace, weaken, or bypass an acceptance body, oracle, retained proptest replay, Contract Shape declaration, or qualified-metal substrate gate.

ADR-0104 is the exact API and persistence contract. Any required public method, type, field, action variant, trait, parameter, or unsanctioned persistence mechanism is a blocking DESIGN gap, not implementation latitude.

Rust tests remain in-process and never spawn the built Overdrive binary or emit expectation evidence. Sim owns ordering/safety/liveness; qualified metal owns real process, Unix-socket, filesystem, clone/index, and cgroup effects.

decomposition.rationale: The fixed three-step DISTILL activation boundary separates pure policy, seeded owner composition, and native host effects; the two production files hold the behavior and its unchanged public action-contract rustdoc.

final_mutation_gate.after: After all three step reviews are APPROVED and qualified-metal evidence is green; run once for the feature, never inside a step.
final_mutation_gate.command: cargo xtask lima run -- cargo xtask mutants --diff origin/main --features integration-tests --package overdrive-reconcilers --file crates/overdrive-reconcilers/src/workload_lifecycle.rs --test-whole-workspace
final_mutation_gate.pass: Wrapper status passes, kill rate is at least 80%, baseline drift is no worse than minus two percentage points, and timeout/unviable outcomes are investigated.
final_mutation_gate.discipline: Do not edit mutation exclusions for this feature.

phases.name: Fresh VM execution identity
phases.description: Land the exact VM-only allocation reservation decision, prove it through seeded production owners, then activate qualified-metal artifact and mesh ownership evidence.

steps.name: Reserve fresh VM execution identities
steps.description: Change WorkloadLifecycle's VM decision and existing View semantics while preserving every Exec, action-shim, lifecycle, observation, network, and public API contract.
criteria: Every initial, generation, Workload Failure, and Platform Reclamation VM start reserves a fresh ID above retained rows and View reservations before dispatch.
VM replacements emit existing StartAllocation with matching action, spec, and SVID identity; Exec retains byte-equivalent same-ID RestartAllocation behavior.
Workload Failure advances candidate budget/time once; generation and Platform Reclamation carry them without increment or restamp; retry deadlines remain current-candidate-only.
View-only reservations never become current; numeric-current history stays immutable; malformed suffixes start canonical minting, MAX-1 issues MAX once, and MAX exhaustion emits no execution.

All fourteen 01-01 scenarios pass with retained proptest replays and exact pure-function Contract Shape declarations; no public shape, persistence field, retry, sleep, lock, or compatibility path appears.

steps.name: Prove production-owner restart isolation
steps.description: Activate the fixed-seed in-process composition that crosses rejected publication, runtime restart, higher-ID recovery, delayed predecessor disposal, and final cleanup.
criteria: Seed 257205 drives registered WorkloadLifecycle, ServiceLifecycle, VmReclamation, action shim, VmDriver, ObservationStore, and redb ViewStore without fabricated rows or private state.
Rejected fresh Running publication creates no row, completes its own awaited cleanup, preserves its reservation across runtime close/reopen, and forces the next accepted VM ID higher.
The accepted fresh row becomes numeric current with zero physical history while the predecessor row and occurrences remain byte-equal and the rejected reservation remains non-current.
Delayed predecessor disposal cannot signal, remove, or author the replacement; repeat reclamation is a no-op; final operator stop removes all three execution artifact sets.
Every provisioned C3/TAP plan has its unchanged teardown pair; the test prints seed and rerun command and remains in-process with no expectation evidence.

steps.name: Prove native artifact ownership
steps.description: Activate six qualified-metal regressions for retained predecessor history, clean clones, SVID re-enrolment, disjoint VM artifacts, syscall ordering, and final cleanup.
criteria: S-VM-28 and S-VM-81 retain PlatformReclaimed predecessors while distinct fresh rows reach Running with zero/None history and replacement SVID coverage.
S-VM-48 boots the fresh allocation from an unmodified clone and leaves the operator rootfs byte-identical while retaining predecessor history.
S-GTI-06a reinstalls fresh SVID and exact mesh guard before EXEC, completes authenticated flow naturally, and leaves predecessor and replacement processes absent.
S-GTI-06b retains the typed INPUT-hook reinstall failure under a fresh zero/None row, releases no EXEC or guest frame, and cleans both processes.

S-284-METAL-01 observes distinct successful beacon binds, second VMM Running, new-create-before-old-cleanup strace ordering, replacement survival, and final absence of both exact artifact families and PIDs.
